summary: Local Health and Wellness reports on the "Unlocking Your Potential" workshop series on goal setting and resilience, held in four sessions at the Riverside Community Center this autumn. Each session is led by a different expert and covers SMART goals, resilience, tracking progress, and the role of social connection. Handouts, checklists and an online forum support participants after the sessions.
one_line: A four-session autumn 2023 workshop series at Riverside Community Center teaches SMART goal setting, resilience, progress tracking and supportive relationships.
key_facts: The "Unlocking Your Potential" workshop series is spread across four sessions at the Riverside Community Center.
The series is conducted by life coach and author Sylvia Richards, who has spent over two decades studying personal achievement and mental toughness.
The note says the series starts September 15, 2023, but the first workshop is listed for September 17th.
The first workshop covers SMART goals: specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound objectives; each attendee outlines a personal or professional goal with steps to achieve it.
The second session on September 24th focuses on resilience and is led by psychologist Dr. John Kaufman, covering mindfulness, self-care, and a supportive social network.
Dr. Kaufman says resilience "is not just having a thick skin; it's about learning how to recover and adapt."
The third workshop on October 1st, "Charting Your Success," is led by cognitive-behavioral therapist Dr. Lily Chang and covers tracking progress and overcoming setbacks.
Dr. Lily Chang states that "detours don't equal defeat."
The final session on October 8th, "The Power of Connection," is led by social psychologist Dr. Michael Peterson and covers how social networks affect goals and resilience.
The Power of Connection workshop also teaches attendees to set boundaries to protect their well-being.
Each session includes handouts, actionable checklists, and access to a dedicated online forum managed by the wellness coaches.
Participants are encouraged to share experiences, challenges and successes to create a shared learning environment.
